metadata.title: PR 6 — TerminologyCard smoke test
metadata.purpose: Validates TerminologyCard with definition, analogy, contextual example, and 'do not confuse with' array.

props.definition: A property of an operation where applying it multiple times yields the same result as applying it once.
props.analogy: Like pressing an elevator call button — pressing it five times doesn't make the elevator come faster.
props.contextualExample: PUT /users/42 with the same body is idempotent; POST /users is not.

doNotConfuseWith.label: Pure functions
doNotConfuseWith.why: Pure functions have no side effects at all; idempotent operations may have effects, just no additional ones on repeat.

doNotConfuseWith.label: Atomic operations
doNotConfuseWith.why: Atomicity is about all-or-nothing execution; idempotency is about repeatability.
